t: Ashton Dulin - Wikipedia
s: December 27, 2025 - Dulin signed with the Indianapolis Colts as an undrafted free agent on April 27, 2019. He was cut by Colts on August 31, but was re-signed to the team's practice squad the following day. Dulin was promoted to the Colts' active roster on September 27.
